info.title: Multi-Hospital Post-Discharge Outreach Platform
info.description: Phase 1 — Foundation: multi-tenant hospital management, JWT authentication, protocol management, tenant isolation, and audit logging.

post.description:
Authenticate with email + password (using OAuth2 form format).

Returns a JWT containing:
    user_id, hospital_id, role

This token must be sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on all protected endpoints.

get.summary: List hospitals (PLATFORM_ADMIN sees all; others see own)

schema.title: Response List Hospitals Api V1 Hospitals Get

put.summary: Update hospital configuration (PLATFORM_ADMIN or own HOSPITAL_ADMIN)

post.summary: Create a user for a hospital (PLATFORM_ADMIN or own HOSPITAL_ADMIN)
post.description:
Creates a user scoped to hospital_id from the URL path.
The body's hospital_id (if any) is IGNORED — the path param is authoritative.

schema.title: Response List Hospital Users Api V1 Hospitals  Hospital Id  Users Get

get.description:
The DB query inside protocol_service.list_protocols() uses tenant.hospital_id,
not the URL's hospital_id, as the primary filter.

post.description: Simulates importing a set number of patient discharges into a hospital's EHR instance.

Create a new Campaign for outbound outreach.

The initial status will always be DRAFT.

Roles allowed: PLATFORM_ADMIN, HOSPITAL_ADMIN, CAMPAIGN_MANAGER.

Mark a Campaign as READY.
It must be fully prepared (validation, queue creation complete).

post.summary: Transition a Campaign to RUNNING status
post.description:
Start a Campaign. 
It must be READY, PAUSED, or SCHEDULED.
Schedule a READY campaign to start automatically at a future time.

post.summary: Run the Outbound Queue Scheduler (Tenant Scoped)
post.description:
Given all queued outbound jobs for the current tenant's hospital, 
determine which patients are callable now, 
select the best patients for currently available call capacity, 
atomically claim those queue items, and hand them off to the call-worker layer.
